title: GigaClaw agent verdict (v1)
description: The single machine-readable judgement shape shared by every reviewer, quality gate and eval judge. Frozen at v1: additive changes only. Consumers treat an invalid verdict as BLOCK.

schemaVersion.description: Verdict contract version. Bumped only for breaking changes.

agent.description: Slug of the reviewing agent, matching its ProjectTemplate directory name.

verdict.description: SHIP = advance. FIX = return to the producing agent (bounded repair loop). BLOCK = stop and escalate to the owner.

summary.description: One-line human-readable justification. Never the machine-readable reason - that is vetoItems and categories.

categories.description: The agent's own rubric, one entry per scored category. Totals are derived, never stored.

vetoItems.description: Hard failures. Any veto item forbids SHIP regardless of score. Empty array when there are none.

evidence.description: What the verdict was derived from: artifacts read, digests computed, links checked.

reviewedAtUtc.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the review completed (must end with Z).

inputDigest.description: sha256 of the exact artifact reviewed. Binds the verdict to its input so a stale verdict can be rejected.

reviewCycle.description: 1-based repair-loop cycle this verdict belongs to, and the cap in force. Informational: the durable counter lives on the ticket.

code.description: Stable machine-checkable identifier for the failure class, e.g. failing-e2e-scenario.

statement.description: What is wrong, stated as a checkable fact rather than an opinion.

evidenceRefs.description: Refs of evidence entries backing this veto item. Every value must appear as an evidence ref.

ref.description: path = workspace-relative file path (no absolute paths, no traversal). hash = sha256:<64 hex>. link = absolute https URL.
